title: Stagiaire Campagnes d'Influence
description:

title: Senior Director, Postmarketing Safety Operations Lead
description:
For more than 25 years, Corcept has been singularly focused on the science of cortisol, a powerful hormone that when unregulated, can play a role in a broad range of diseases.

Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. With advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and liver disease, Corcept is unlocking the power of cortisol modulation to help address some of the most devastating diseases patients face today. 

Corcept is headquartered in Redwood City, California. To learn more, visit www.corcept.com .

As Corcept's portfolio and international presence continue to expand, the Patient Safety & Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) organization is expanding its capabilities to support the company's growing portfolio of innovative medicines. We are seeking a talented and experienced leader to serve as Senior Director, Postmarketing Safety Operations Lead and provide strategic and operational leadership for global postmarketing safety operations.

The function includes two complementary areas: Case Management Operations, Postmarketing Safety and External Engagement, Postmarketing Safety .

The Senior Director will provide strategic and operational leadership across global postmarketing safety case management and external safety-data channels, including case management vendors, specialty pharmacies, hubs, patient support programs, and other external partners. The role will build and scale the operating model, drive operational excellence, vendor performance, data quality, and continuous improvement, and develop the capabilities needed to support Corcept's expanding commercial and international footprint.

As a member of the PSPV Leadership Team, this leader will work closely across PSPV (Medical Safety, Safety Sciences, Epidemiology, Clinical Trial Patient Safety, Safety Systems, Business Operations, and QPPVs), as well as Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and other functions across Corcept.

Responsibilities:

• Lead global postmarketing safety operations supporting Corcept's marketed-product portfolio

• Lead and develop the Case Management Operations and External Engagement functions, establishing a cohesive global operating model

• Provide strategic oversight of global outsourced ICSR processing and vendor performance

• Establish effective operational processes across specialty pharmacies, hubs, patient support programs, and other external sources of safety information

• Build strong partnerships with international stakeholders and external service providers to support consistent, high-quality execution across markets

• Drive operational performance through meaningful KPIs, quality metrics, governance, and continuous improvement

• Lead development and maintenance of functional SOPs, procedures, and other operational standards

• Partner with Safety Systems to advance technology, automation, data integration, and digital capabilities supporting postmarketing safety

• Partner with PV Compliance, Business Operations, and Quality on the implementation of standards, training, audits, inspections, and operational readiness

• Partner with QPPVs to support effective international PV operations and oversight

• Support postmarketing safety readiness for regulatory submissions, inspections, product launches, and lifecycle activities

• Build organizational capabilities, develop talent, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and quality

• Serve as a key member of the PSPV Leadership Team and contribute to broader PSPV strategy and organizational growth

Preferred Skills, Qualifications and Technical Proficiencies:

• Bachelor's degree in pharmacy, nursing, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred

• 14+ years of patient safety/pharmacovigilance experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnol

Designing the compute-and-power architecture that makes this possible is the heart of the role.

- Electronics design and integration - power distribution, battery systems, motor/thruster control, sensor interfaces (acoustic, pressure, IMU, GNSS, AIS).

title: Fixed Asset Manager (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

As our Fixed Asset Manager (f/m/d), you will build the fixed asset function from the ground up, creating the processes, controls, and documentation that keep our asset base accurate, audit-ready, and scalable. There is no single owner of fixed asset judgment across our entities today, so you will set the standards and become the go-to expert for the entire company.

You will work directly with the Director of Operational Finance and partner closely with Accounting, Procurement, and the operations teams at our sites.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the annual fixed asset inventory: Plan and run the year-end physical inventory and reconcile the results to the asset register.

- Structure the asset register: Define clear data standards, and maintain an accurate, reconciled register across all entities.

- Define the capitalization lifecycle: Set up a clear, documented process from construction in progress (CIP) to asset activation, including capitalization decisions, depreciation tables, impairment, and disposals.

- Manage public funding bookings: Establish the booking logic for subsidized assets, including treatment of grants and the related depreciation and reporting requirements.

- Automate the purchase-to-asset process: Work with Procurement to design a documented, automated flow from purchase order to capitalized asset in NetSuite and NetAssets.

- Build procedures and enable the team: Document policies and work instructions, so the process runs reliably, and hand over clear procedures to the emerging team.

- Partner across the business: Work with project, construction, and site teams to get timely, reliable information on assets under construction and assets placed into service.

- Support audit readiness: Prepare reconciliations and supporting documentation, and act as the day-to-day contact for external auditors on fixed asset matters.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Solid experience in fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, construction in progress, depreciation methods and lifetime tables, impairment, and disposals

- Experience with public funding, grants, or subsidy booking

- Hands-on experience with year-end physical inventories, asset reconciliations, and working with external auditors

- A process improvement and documentation mindset, with an openness to using automation and AI tools to make finance work more efficient

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to build structure in an environment that is still taking shape

- Clear communication skills in English and German

- Comfort working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and procurement colleagues

NICE TO HAVE

- Working knowledge of NetSuite and/or NetAssets, with an interest in improving systems and processes

- Experience in a manufacturing, energy, or capital-intensive industry with significant assets under construction

- Experience setting up a function from scratch or documenting processes for a growing team

 

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people

Maira Russo - Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

title: Research Scientist, Video & Multimodal
description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

Video is where multimodal models are weakest and hardest to grade. Temporal reasoning, long-form understanding, grounding events in time, and holding audio, video, and text together do not fall out of image benchmarks - and the evaluations for them are still immature. Closing that gap is gated as much by how we design data and evaluation as by architecture. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing video and multimodal models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it.

You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building video understanding, video-language, and video-generation models, as interested in the data behind them as in the models themselves. Video spans two model families judged in completely different ways: models that understand video - answering questions, localizing events, grounding language in time - where the question is whether the answer is correct; and models that generate it, where fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility matter and no automatic metric is settled. You own the evaluation science for both, and knowing when model-based scoring can stand in for a human versus when it can't. Your conclusions shape what our partners measure and collect next.

What You’ll Own:

You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates video data for video and multimodal models, and you will validate those choices experimentally. Concretely, you will:

• Translate the requirements of video and multimodal models - video understanding, temporal and event localization, action recognition, long-form video, video-language models, video generation, cross-modal reasoning, and multimodal retrieval and grounding - into concrete data specifications: modalities, annotation schemas, sampling, and evaluation criteria.

• Build evaluation methodology for video understanding - temporal grounding accuracy, long-context and long-horizon reasoning, and dynamic multi-turn, cross-modal, and retrieval-and-grounding evaluation - clear about when model-based scoring is trustworthy and when a human is needed.

• Build evaluation methodology for video generation - fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility, including generative video used as a world model - the regime where automatic metrics are weakest and human judgment matters most.

• Decide how existing and incoming video should be structured, enriched, and sampled to extract the most model value from it, including from messy, domain-specific footage.

• Run experiments that prove data decisions matter: fine-tune and evaluate models on Innodata data, with ablations tying specific data choices to measurable improvement.

• Design adversarial and stumping evaluations that surface where video and multimodal systems fail, and turn those failures into better data.

• Publish. Turn what you learn into benchmarks, methodology, and papers that advance the field and earn the trust of the customers and frontier labs we partner with.

• Work with annotation teams, subject-matter experts, and the synthetic-data pipeline to turn specifications into operational collection and labeling plans.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

• Roughly 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in video understanding or multimodal ML. We weight practical experience over formal

Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Opportunity

The Ops Data Analyst role delivers accurate, timely and reliable insight across operational domains, including Clinical Operations, Medical, Customer Support and Physical Operations.

This role has a particular focus on physical and operational performance, including dispatch, SLA adherence, workflow volumes, supply chain management  and fulfilment metrics, while also able to support the other areas of Ops analytics where required.

• Identify trends and drivers within operational datasets and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Support & Structured Analysis

• Translate stakeholder questions into structured analytical approaches

• Deliver medium-complexity analyses

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT US

Motorway is the first and largest car-selling marketplace in the UK, connecting private sellers directly with over 8,000 verified dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve market leading prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want to grow their businesses profitably.

Founded in 2017, Motorway's technology-led approach has transformed the car-selling experience. We now facilitate hundreds of thousands of car sales each year, with 2,500 cars in our daily auction. We employ 400+ people across the UK. Valued at over $1bn and backed by leading global technology investors, including Index and Iconiq. Motorway is now entering a critical phase focused on scale, growth and profitability. As Commercial Director of Dealer Solutions, you will own what happens after Motorway's daily auction closes: inspecting and transporting the car, making sure everyone gets paid, and helping dealers fund the stock they buy. The Commercial Director reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer, James Wilson, and is part of Motorway's senior leadership team.

- Improve reliability, speed and cost so dealers and sellers get a fast, predictable experience

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience in administrative support, virtual assistance, customer service or marketing/sales support.

title: Senior PVD Equipment Engineer
description:
Senior PVD Equipment Engineer
Company Overview
Vital Materials is a global technology organization with operations in over 20 countries, providing advanced materials, products, and solutions across markets including semiconductors, optics, consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, and energy-related applications. The company is committed to enabling next-generation technologies through materials science and process innovation.
Job Summary
The Senior PVD Equipment Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for the design, development, build, and troubleshooting of physical vapor deposition (PVD) equipment, with a strong emphasis on magnetron sputtering systems. This position supports R&D, pilot-scale, and manufacturing operations, particularly for thin-film deposition of magnetic materials.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop PVD equipment and subsystems with emphasis on magnetic sputtering and magnetron configurations.

• Lead equipment architecture decisions including vacuum systems, gas and power delivery, magnetron design, and target assemblies.

• Oversee build, installation, commissioning, and qualification of sputtering tools.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment issues related to plasma stability, film uniformity, arcing, target wear, and magnetic field non-uniformity.

• Support sputtering processes for magnetic and non-magnetic materials in R&D and manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate with process, materials, and operations teams to optimize tool performance and reliability.

• Develop and maintain equipment documentation and preventative maintenance procedures.

• Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities and equipment upgrades.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

• Extensive hands-on experience designing, building, and troubleshooting magnetron sputtering tools.

• Strong practical knowledge of PVD sputtering processes.

• Direct experience with sputtering of magnetic materials strongly preferred.

• Solid understanding of vacuum systems, plasma physics, RF/DC power supplies, and magnetic field design.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and lead complex technical projects.

Pay Range & Total Compensation
The base pay range reflects the good-faith estimate of the salary/wage range for this position at the time of posting. Actual placement within the range is determined based on factors including key skills, relevant experience, internal equity, education, certifications, and geography/market differentials.
Additional Compensation & Benefits:
In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for:

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage

• 401(k) matching program

• Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and sick leave

Note: Variable pay and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents.

Required

• 3+ years of backend software engineering experience with Python

- Proven ownership of at least one working two-way voice application or conversational product with spoken interaction. Be ready to explain your contribution, architecture, latency, interruption handling, failure recovery and usage costs.

- Third-party API integration, secure session handling, SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, PDF generation and reliable export workflows.
- Automated testing and debugging across the browser, backend and AI services; Git, code review, deployment pipelines, Docker or equivalent packaging, and one cloud environment.
- Clear written English and the ability to translate a business requirement into a small, testable release, explaining assumptions and trade-offs to a non-technical project lead.

Absorb or another LMS; LTI 1.3, OIDC/SSO or secure external-tool launches; multi-tenant SaaS; rubric-based AI evaluation; training/coaching products; insurance workflows; document retrieval; and integrations with Sheets, BigQuery, HubSpot or Zapier. The successful candidates will have a training day in a face to face environment (location tbc)

The Ministry of Defence (MOD) is a central government department with a mission to protect our country and provide the ultimate guarantee of its security and independence, as well as helping to protect its values and interests abroad.

The MOD is one of the biggest public procurement organisations in Europe and the single largest customer for UK industry. It currently manages approximately £20 billion of spend on capital investments in equipment and infrastructure every year. Over the next decade the MOD is committed to spending over £190 billion on equipment and support. The MOD’s customers include both the armed forces and national security agencies, and it has a diverse range of requirements, including military fighting vehicles, education services, nuclear submarines and facilities management.

The MOD’s aim is to provide its armed forces with the best capabilities to enable them to protect the UK’s security and advance national interests, both now and in the long term.

To do this the MOD has an annual budget of almost £53 billion and a workforce comprising 197,000 people. of which 54,000 are civilians working for the UK MOD.

The work really matters; the MOD offers a range of engaging roles which have a direct impact on the quality of services they provide, in many locations across the UK. We support teams working in HR, Primary Health Care, Corporate Services, and many others.

As a LOPT Redaction Officer, your main responsibilities will be:

• Identify and redact information requiring protection on national security grounds .

• Redact sensitive names, locations and operational references .

Essential:

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy .

• Good general administration skills.

• Able to read and understand document context .

• Good understanding of data protection and sensitive information .

• Able to follow redaction guidance and identify sensitive material .

• Comfortable applying national security redactions .

•
Case management experience is not essential . The focus is redaction, not managing cases.

• Must be a UK citizen.

Desirable:

title: Head of Banking Operations - Luxembourg
description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Banking Operations, you’ll play a key role in making sure every euro of our customers’ money moves, settles, and reconciles safely, at scale.

- Payment rails and cards - Own SEPA, TARGET, domestic schemes, securities and fund rails, and the money side of cards. Cover foreign exchange where products need it, and keep us compliant with scheme rules.

- Reconciliation - Reconcile all client money daily. Every break gets an owner, a date, and a root cause, and you always know how much is unreconciled, how old it is, and what it could cost.

- Scale and efficiency - Handle much higher volumes through process and automation, not headcount. That means fewer failed or delayed payments, fewer manual steps, lower cost per transaction, and lower operational losses.

- New products - Get every product ready to launch, with the right accounts, rails and controls from day one.

- Partners and expertise - Manage banks, processors and other partners, with a tested backup behind each critical one. Be the company’s payments expert and give Customer Operations accurate explanations to use as they are.

- Team - Hire, structure, and develop the Banking Operations team.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results, and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.

- European payment infrastructure expertise - Deep expertise across the landscape: SEPA rulebooks and R-transactions, card schemes and processing, SWIFT and TARGET. You have personally delivered at least one major scheme migration.

- Securities & fund operations - Hands-on exposure to securities, custody, or fund operations.

- Operations leadership - Experience running (not just supervising) operations in a licensed institution (bank, electronic money/payment institution, or payment processor).

- Financial rigor - Proven experience owning a reconciliation estate and driving breaks and operational losses down. A two-cent difference bothers you as much as a two-thousand-euro one - and you know which to fix first.

- Team builder - Demonstrated success in hiring, structuring, and leveling an operations team.

- Scaler - Track record of taking operations through a step change in volume using automation and process rather than headcount.

- Credibility - Highly credible across the table from correspondent banks, schemes, and regulators.

- Fast-paced environment fit - At home in a fast-growing, product-driven company: challenged by engineers and product managers, and challenging back with data.

- Location - Based in Luxembourg, or ready to relocate (required).

- Languages - Fluent English. Italian is a plus.

title: Strategy Manager - All genders
description:
The Role (What’s in the Box)

For our Nordic Head Office in Copenhagen, we are seeking a highly ambitious, analytical, and results-driven Strategy Manager to join our small, high-performing Strategy team. This team serves as the strategic partner and trusted advisor to the Nordic Senior Leadership, driving the region's long-term strategy and overseeing critical cross-functional initiatives. This role reports to the Head of Strategy, and is based in our vibrant Islands Brygge office in Copenhagen. 

This is a highly cross-functional role in which you will collaborate with both commercial and operational sides of our business to ensure strategic coherence and effective execution, directly influencing the trajectory of our multi-market Nordic business.

If you are an exceptional strategist who thrives on data-driven storytelling as well as tackling complex business problems with structure, urgency and strong stakeholder management, this could be the perfect opportunity!

 

What You’ll Do (The Recipe)

Strategy Development & Insight

• Strategy formulation: Partner with the Strategy Team and Senior Leadership to drive the annual, mid- and long-term strategy development cycle.

• Business case creation: Conduct deep-dive market research, competitor analysis, and rigorous financial modeling to build compelling business cases that inform and prioritize the Nordic market strategy.

• Business performance analysis: Proactively analyze business performance, identify growth opportunities, and translate complex data into clear, actionable strategic insights.

Strategic Execution & Oversight

• Initiative leadership: Own and drive key strategic business initiatives, often focusing on the early, ambiguous project stages (e.g., problem definition, in-depth analysis, and go/no-go recommendation).

• Rhythm of business: Contribute to the preparation and organization of regular strategy reviews, executive updates, and management meetings.

• Ad-hoc problem solving: Support cross-functional leaders by providing sharp, ad hoc analysis, rigorous problem-solving, and structured project management support in critical, high-priority areas.

• Sustainability reporting: Lead the local sustainability reporting and coordination effort, acting as the key liaison between Nordic stakeholders and our Global teams.

Stakeholder Communication & Management

• Executive communication: Contribute to designing and delivering high-quality, impactful presentations for the Nordic Senior Leadership Team and Global stakeholders.

• Organizational communication: Contribute to driving clear communication and alignment regarding business progress and strategic focus areas across the wider organization (e.g., All Hands meetings).

What You’ll Bring (Your Ingredients)

• BSc/MSc in Business, Economics or another quantitative field of study

•

2-5+ years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business development or a similar field.

• Exceptional business acumen coupled with an analytical mindset, comfortable with interpreting and structuring data to extract valuable insights, as well as building robust financial models.

• Solid project and stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated "get things done" attitude, including managing simultaneous priorities under tight deadlines.

• Fluency in English with outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to distill complex issues into clear, concise narratives for an executive audience.

• HelloFresh Discounts - Enjoy 65% off your HelloFresh Meal Box and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

• Learning and Development - Make the most of a dedicated Learning & Development Space and the HelloMint mentorship program.

• Receive 25 days of paid vacation per year, + 5 days of  feriefridage . Paid leave also provided for your child’s first sick day.

• Parent Benefits - Benefit from a Parental Leave policy supporting your family needs.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

About the Team

Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.

We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.

You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.

You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.

Working alongside engineers responsible for the shared runtime and platform services, you will turn feedback from early users into better interfaces, defaults, tests and guidance. You will identify reusable patterns across integrations, shape shared platform capabilities, review designs and mentor colleagues. You will use coding agents and automation to accelerate development, applying the review, testing and domain judgement needed to ensure the resulting software behaves as intended.

Qualifications:

• Strong software engineering skills, demonstrated through dependable software or developer tools used by other people.

• Applied depth in at least one relevant area, such as robotics simulation, autonomous-vehicle evaluation, reinforcement learning, synthetic-data generation or engineering simulation.

• Experience making specialist or research software usable beyond its original author, including configuration, testing, documentation and diagnosis.

• Sound judgement about experimental assumptions, evaluation criteria, reproducibility and the conclusions a result supports.

• Familiarity with containerised execution and experience tracing problems across application and infrastructure boundaries.

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and domains, working closely with specialists and recognising when their expertise is needed.

title: Director, Data Science
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab .

An Overview of this Role
As Director, Data Science, you'll lead GitLab 's Product, Sales, and Finance Data Science teams and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You have two mandates:

•
Make Data Science a driver of growth. Connect the team's work to GitLab 's biggest priorities: supporting product innovation, making sure what we launch is improved and scaled with data, improving product adoption through our GTM motions, and growing the consumption business. Make sure the work changes decisions at the executive level.

•
Set the bar for great data science. Define what makes a great Data Scientist at GitLab , from business partnership to technical rigor, and develop managers who build teams where everyone shows up to that standard.

You lead through your managers with an overall team size of 12 including data scientists and analysts, ensuring direction with the team across the data organization, and staying close enough to the work to pressure-test the analyses and models that matter most.
What you’ll do

• Build trusted relationships with executives across Product, Finance, and GTM, and act as their thought partner, shaping the questions the business should be asking, not just answering them

• Own investment and prioritization across teams: decide where Data Science spends its time, and make trade-offs visible to senior leaders

• Lead high-impact, cross-functional programs, such as driving new product adoption and growing our consumption business, from strategy through measurable business impact

• Coach and mentor managers and senior ICs to grow as leaders, building succession and a bench of future leaders

• Hold a high talent bar, and make sure every teammate grows into a trusted thought partner in their area

• Set org-wide standards for metric definition, causal inference, and predictive modeling, and the role of AI in each

• Build a high-trust culture of urgency, accountability, and open communication, and act on engagement and feedback across teams

• Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and other data teams across the company to solve data opportunities together, aligned on a shared data and AI roadmap

What you’ll bring

• 12+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, including 6+ years leading teams and 3+ years managing managers in B2B SaaS or tech

• Track record of building and scaling a data science or analytics organization that executives treat as a strategic partner

• Strong business acumen across product and go-to-market, with experience connecting data work to revenue and growth outcomes

• Executive presence: communicates complex

title: Strategic Account Executive, Air Majors
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As an Account Executive for Axon Air (drones & counter-drone solutions), you will spearhead 0-to-1 statewide safety initiatives alongside senior public safety leaders and law enforcement executives. Partnering closely with Key Account Leaders and key strategic partners-including Skydio-you will own complex, high-impact engagements to build and scale Drone as a First Responder (DFR) and low-altitude public safety programs across major state agencies. We are looking for a strategic, autonomous builder driven to redefine public safety operations across entire states.

Location: Remote (Centrally located preferred)

Territory: National 

Travel: 60%+

What You’ll Do

• Statewide Strategy: Build, own, and scale multi-state territories, driving adoption of DFR and low-altitude public safety solutions across state police and highway patrol agencies.

• Strategic Advisory & Alliances: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders while maximizing strategic partner ecosystems (e.g., Skydio) to deliver integrated, real-time operational outcomes.

• Domain Expertise: Develop deep technical proficiency in Axon Air solutions, serving as the core subject matter expert across internal sales teams and executive customer stakeholders.

• Pipeline Creation: Proactively identify, qualify, and close high-value opportunities leveraging RFPs, Google Alerts, market intelligence, and executive networking.

• Cross-Functional Execution: Orchestrate account strategies alongside internal cross-functional partners and maintain rigorous CRM discipline in Salesforce for forecasting and pipeline management.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent applicable experience

• 7+ years of SaaS Account Executive experience driving complex, consultative solution sales.

• Proven full-lifecycle sales expertise: prospecting, discovery, technical demos, objection handling, and closing major accounts.

• Solid technical aptitude in drone technologies, cloud software, and virtualization solutions.

• Demonstrated success navigating 0-to-1 entrepreneurial builds or new vertical expansion initiatives.

• Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent enterprise CRMs, as well as standard productivity tools (MS Office / G-Suite).

• Willingness to travel 60%+ within territory (3-4 days per week, including overnights).

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applicable experience.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. 😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture.  We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.  

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.  

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀 About the Role
As a Strategic Account Executive at Quantum Metric, you will steward and grow a key industry territory, driving full-cycle “land-and-expand” sales into Fortune 500 accounts. We seek a results-oriented individual motivated by professional growth, impact, and high-performance rewards.

As a key member of our enterprise sales team, you will leverage enterprise SaaS sales expertise to engage diverse stakeholders-including C-suite executives and digital product leaders-to diagnose challenges, develop rigorous solutions, and quantify ROI. Our team is a fast-growing unit already partnered with market-leading enterprise organizations across North America. We provide a supportive, inclusive, and collaborative culture where talented professionals can grow, thrive, and make a significant impact.

title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations. We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include: Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities. Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs. Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads. Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes. Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items. Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Over ons

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

- Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

- Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

- Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

- Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

- Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

Jouw kwalificaties

- Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

- Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

- Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

- Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

- Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

- Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

- In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.
